meta.title: 我要多向认真的人学习
meta.titleEn: I will learn from people who are careful
meta.topic: 面对错误、学习榜样、继续学习、留学准备与毕业选择
meta.courseModel: A向认真者学习→B明确学习方向→C准备与毕业打算
meta.sourceTextPolicy: 教材事实来自L17.txt；原始“名择”按用户确认更正为“选择”；所有新增内容标记teaching_extension。
editorialAudit: 教材语法例句原始文件将“选择”误写为“名择”；用户于2026-11-05确认课程统一使用“选择”。
英文标题按教材文件和用户确认使用“I will learn from people who are careful”。

pedagogy.speakingParticipation: 每位学生有效发言；C课堂展示，不上传音频。

sessions.title: 第一次课：我想向谁学习
sessions.communicativeGoal: 介绍一个自己想向他或她学习的人，并说明理由。

sessions.title: 第二次课：我的学习方向
sessions.communicativeGoal: 说出自己想继续学习的内容，并请同学给一个建议。

sessions.title: 第三次课：我的下一步计划
sessions.communicativeGoal: 介绍想去学习的地方和准备办法，并说明毕业后想工作还是继续学习以及理由。

formalResourcePlan.title: 我想向谁学习
formalResourcePlan.goal: 从说一个做事认真的人，到说出想向谁学习和理由。
formalResourcePlan.goalEn: Move from naming a careful person to naming a role model and one reason.
formalResourcePlan.entry: 说一个你觉得“很认真”的人。

formalResourcePlan.title: 我的学习方向
formalResourcePlan.goal: 从选择学习还是工作，到说出想继续学习什么并请同学给建议。
formalResourcePlan.goalEn: Move from a broad choice to a learning direction and a request for advice.
formalResourcePlan.entry: 你以后想继续学习还是工作？
formalResourcePlan.exit: 说说你想继续学习什么，并请同学给你一个建议。

formalResourcePlan.title: 我要怎么准备
formalResourcePlan.goal: 从说一个想去的地方，到说出想去学习的地方和一种准备办法。
formalResourcePlan.goalEn: Move from naming a place to naming a study destination and one preparation step.
formalResourcePlan.entry: 你想去哪个国家或城市学习？
formalResourcePlan.exit: 介绍一个你想去学习的国家或城市，说说你要怎么准备？

formalResourcePlan.title: 毕业后的打算
formalResourcePlan.goal: 从回答以后想做什么，到选择工作或继续学习并说出理由。
formalResourcePlan.goalEn: Move from a broad future question to choosing work or further study with one reason.
formalResourcePlan.exit: 介绍你毕业以后的打算：工作还是继续学习？为什么？

grammar.title: 介词“向”
grammar.scene: 动作朝向一个地方，或一个人向另一个人学习、请教。
grammar.structure: 向 + 地方/人 + 动作
grammar.explanation: 介词“向”后加代词、名词或名词性短语，表示动作的方向或对象。

examples.hanzi: 别再向前走了。
examples.pinyin: Bié zài xiàng qián zǒu le.
examples.english: Do not walk forward any farther.

examples.hanzi: 以后我要多向认真的人学习。
examples.pinyin: Yǐhòu wǒ yào duō xiàng rènzhēn de rén xuéxí.
examples.english: From now on, I will learn more from people who are careful.

examples.hanzi: 孩子一看见妈妈，就向她跑过去了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yí kànjiàn māma, jiù xiàng tā pǎo guòqu le.
examples.english: As soon as the child saw his mother, he ran toward her.

examples.hanzi: 我想向同桌学习，因为他做事很认真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiàng tóngzhuō xuéxí, yīnwèi tā zuòshì hěn rènzhēn.
examples.english: I want to learn from my deskmate because he works carefully.

examples.hanzi: 有问题的时候，我会向老师请教。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí de shíhou, wǒ huì xiàng lǎoshī qǐngjiào.
examples.english: When I have a question, I ask the teacher for help.

grammar.title: 反问句“不是……吗？”
grammar.scene: 朋友根据已经知道的信息进行提醒、确认或提出建议。
grammar.structure: 主语 + 不是 + 已知情况 + 吗？
grammar.explanation: 反问句“不是……吗？”可表达不理解、不满、提醒或确认；否定形式表达肯定意思。

examples.hanzi: 你不是喜欢玩电脑吗？你可以去看看跟电脑有关系的书。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì xǐhuan wán diànnǎo ma? Nǐ kěyǐ qù kànkan gēn diànnǎo yǒu guānxì de shū.
examples.english: Do you not like computers? You can look at books related to computers.

examples.hanzi: 你不是说今天有事吗？你怎么来了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān yǒu shì ma? Nǐ zěnme lái le?
examples.english: Did you not say you were busy today? Why did you come?

examples.hanzi: 考试不是下个月吗？你怎么今天就开始复习了？
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì bú shì xià ge yuè ma? Nǐ zěnme jīntiān jiù kāishǐ fùxí le?
examples.english: Is the exam not next month? Why did you start reviewing today?

examples.hanzi: 你不是想继续学习吗？我们一起去图书馆看看吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì xiǎng jìxù xuéxí ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn kànkan ba.
examples.english: Do you not want to continue studying? Let us look in the library.

examples.hanzi: 你不是对设计感兴趣吗？可以先查一查有关的课程。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì duì shèjì gǎn xìngqù ma? Kěyǐ xiān chá yi chá yǒuguān de kèchéng.
examples.english: Are you not interested in design? You can first research related courses.

grammar.title: 递进复句“……，更……”
grammar.scene: 第一个想法还没有确定，第二个问题比第一个更难确定。
grammar.explanation: 第二个分句表示在第一个分句的基础上程度更深一层。

examples.hanzi: 我还没想好学什么，更没想好去哪个国家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo xué shénme, gèng méi xiǎnghǎo qù nǎge guójiā.
examples.english: I have not decided what to study, much less which country to go to.

examples.hanzi: 想提高中文水平要多听多看，更要多说多练。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng tígāo Zhōngwén shuǐpíng yào duō tīng duō kàn, gèng yào duō shuō duō liàn.
examples.english: To improve Chinese, listen and read more, and even more importantly speak and practise more.

examples.hanzi: 来中国学习，我学会了中文，更了解了中国文化。
examples.pinyin: Lái Zhōngguó xuéxí, wǒ xuéhuìle Zhōngwén, gèng liǎojiěle Zhōngguó wénhuà.
examples.english: Studying in China, I learned Chinese and gained a deeper understanding of Chinese culture.

examples.hanzi: 选学校要看课程，更要看这个方向适不适合自己。
examples.pinyin: Xuǎn xuéxiào yào kàn kèchéng, gèng yào kàn zhège fāngxiàng shì bu shìhé zìjǐ.
examples.english: When choosing a school, look at courses and, more importantly, whether the direction suits you.

examples.english: I want to learn about this country and even more about university life there.

grammar.title: 条件复句“只有……，才……”
grammar.scene: 从多个选择中先确定不可少的条件，再做决定。
grammar.structure: 只有 + 必要条件，+ 才 + 结果

texts.title: 做错以后怎么办
texts.setting: 在教学楼里，刘小雪和同学边走边聊。

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 别再向前走了，李老师的办公室已经到了。
lines.pinyin: Bié zài xiàng qián zǒu le, Lǐ lǎoshī de bàngōngshì yǐjīng dào le.
lines.english: Don't walk forward anymore; Teacher Li's office is already here.

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 你进去吧，我在楼梯那儿等你。我害怕见李老师。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jìnqu ba, wǒ zài lóutī nàr děng nǐ. Wǒ hàipà jiàn Lǐ lǎoshī.
lines.english: You go in; I'll wait for you by the stairs. I'm afraid of seeing Teacher Li.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 怎么回事？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme huí shì?
lines.english: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 最近我做错了好几件事，我怕李老师生气。
lines.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ zuòcuò le hǎo jǐ jiàn shì, wǒ pà Lǐ lǎoshī shēngqì.
lines.english: I've done several things wrong recently, and I'm afraid Teacher Li is angry.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 你想多了，做错事情是很常见的。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng duō le, zuòcuò shìqing shì hěn chángjiàn de.
lines.english: You're overthinking. Making mistakes is very common.

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 我把简单的事情做错了，李老师一定觉得我不认真。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ jiǎndān de shìqing zuòcuò le, Lǐ lǎoshī yídìng juéde wǒ bù rènzhēn.
lines.english: I made mistakes on simple things; Teacher Li must think I'm not being conscientious.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 有的人虽然很聪明，但是会在简单的事情中出错，因为他们认为事情简单，就不会认真去做。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu de rén suīrán hěn cōngming, dànshì huì zài jiǎndān de shìqing zhōng chūcuò, yīnwèi tāmen rènwéi shìqing jiǎndān, jiù bú huì rènzhēn qù zuò.
lines.english: Some people are very smart, but make mistakes in simple things because they assume it's easy and don't take it seriously.

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 你说得就是我，以后我要多向认真的人学习。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de jiù shì wǒ, yǐhòu wǒ yào duō xiàng rènzhēn de rén xuéxí.
lines.english: You're describing me! From now on, I need to learn more from conscientious people.

texts.title: 去图书馆找方向
texts.setting: 在阅览室门口，白家月碰到了陈天中。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 太阳从西边出来了？这几天怎么总是在图书馆看见你？
lines.pinyin: Tàiyáng cóng xībian chūlai le? Zhè jǐ tiān zěnme zǒngshì zài túshūguǎn kànjiàn nǐ?
lines.english: Did the sun rise from the west? How come I always see you in the library these days?

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.hanzi: 这有什么奇怪的？我是来学习的。
lines.pinyin: Zhè yǒu shénme qíguài de? Wǒ shì lái xuéxí de.
lines.english: What's so strange about that? I came to study.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 你怎么还来图书馆学习？同学们都在到处找工作呢。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme hái lái túshūguǎn xuéxí? Tóngxuémen dōu zài dàochù zhǎo gōngzuò ne.
lines.english: Why are you still coming to the library to study? The other classmates are all looking for jobs everywhere.

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.hanzi: 我不想现在就工作，还想继续学习，我爸妈也同意。可我还没想好学什么，所以来图书馆看看。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng xiànzài jiù gōngzuò, hái xiǎng jìxù xuéxí, wǒ bàmā yě tóngyì. Kě wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo xué shénme, suǒyǐ lái túshūguǎn kànkan.
lines.english: I don't want to work right now; I'd like to continue studying, and my parents agree. But I haven't decided what to study yet, so I came to the library to look around.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 你不是喜欢玩电脑吗？你可以去看看跟电脑有关系的书。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì xǐhuan wán diànnǎo ma? Nǐ kěyǐ qù kànkan gēn diànnǎo yǒu guānxì de shū.
lines.english: Don't you like working with computers? You can go check out some books related to computers.

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.hanzi: 你说得对，我记得那个屋子里有些跟电脑有关的书，我去找找。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì, wǒ jìde nàge wūzi li yǒuxiē gēn diànnǎo yǒuguān de shū, wǒ qù zhǎozhao.
lines.english: You're right. I remember there are some books related to computers in that room; I'll go have a look.

texts.title: 查一查留学信息
texts.setting: 在校园里，李文和陈天中在聊天儿。

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 天中，你的手机怎么关机了？
lines.pinyin: Tiānzhōng, nǐ de shǒujī zěnme guānjī le?
lines.english: Tianzhong, why was your phone turned off?

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.hanzi: 我的手机没电了。你找我有事吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī méi diàn le. Nǐ zhǎo wǒ yǒu shì ma?
lines.english: My phone ran out of battery. Did you need something from me?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 前天我看见家月了，她告诉我你打算继续留学？
lines.pinyin: Qiántiān wǒ kànjiàn Jiāyuè le, tā gàosu wǒ nǐ dǎsuàn jìxù liúxué?
lines.english: I saw Jiayue the day before yesterday, and she told me you plan to continue studying abroad?

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.hanzi: 是，可是我还没想好学什么，更没想好去哪个国家。
lines.pinyin: Shì, kěshì wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo xué shénme, gèng méi xiǎnghǎo qù nǎge guójiā.
lines.english: Yes, but I haven't figured out what to study yet, much less which country to go to.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 你可以去中国学中文啊。比如可以去北京、上海这样的大城市，那里有很多好大学，也有很多留学生。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ qù Zhōngguó xué Zhōngwén a. Bǐrú kěyǐ qù Běijīng, Shànghǎi zhèyàng de dà chéngshì, nàli yǒu hěn duō hǎo dàxué, yě yǒu hěn duō liúxuéshēng.
lines.english: You can go to China to learn Chinese. For example, you could go to big cities like Beijing or Shanghai; there are many great universities and international students there.

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.hanzi: 好，那我上网查一查。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ shàngwǎng chá yi chá.
lines.english: Okay, then I'll look it up online.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 我给你介绍几个有用的网站。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ jièshào jǐ gè yǒuyòng de wǎngzhàn.
lines.english: Let me recommend a few useful websites for you.

texts.title: 毕业后的选择
texts.author: 陈天中
texts.setting: 在家里，陈天中在写日记。

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.hanzi: 大学生活马上就要结束了，我最近经常被问到一个问题——“你以后想做什么”，这个问题真不容易回答。我也问了几个同学，大家选择的方向都不同。有的想继续在学校学习，有的打算出国留学，还有的决定先找工作。我认为只有想清楚自己真正喜欢什么，才能做出最合适的选择。对我来说，想清楚“真正喜欢什么”是个难题。
lines.pinyin: Dàxué shēnghuó mǎshàng jiù yào jiéshù le, wǒ zuìjìn jīngcháng bèi wèndào yí gè wèntí——“nǐ yǐhòu xiǎng zuò shénme”, zhège wèntí zhēn bù róngyì huídá. Wǒ yě wènle jǐ gè tóngxué, dàjiā xuǎnzé de fāngxiàng dōu bù tóng. Yǒude xiǎng jìxù zài xuéxiào xuéxí, yǒude dǎsuàn chūguó liúxué, hái yǒude juédìng xiān zhǎo gōngzuò. Wǒ rènwéi zhǐyǒu xiǎng qīngchu zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xǐhuan shénme, cái néng zuòchū zuì héshì de xuǎnzé. Duì wǒ lái shuō, xiǎng qīngchu “zhēnzhèng xǐhuan shénme” shì ge nántí.
lines.english: University life is about to end. Recently, I am often asked a question—'What do you want to do in the future?' This question is really not easy to answer. I also asked several classmates, and everyone chose a different direction. Some want to continue studying at school, some plan to study abroad, and others decide to find a job first. I think only by figuring out what you truly like can you make the most suitable choice. For me, figuring out what I 'truly like' is a difficult problem.

A.prompt_cn: 完成榜样卡：你想向谁学习？这个人做什么很认真？你想学习什么？
A.prompt_en: Bring one privacy-safe drawing, public image, or name card for a role model. Say who you want to learn from, what careful action this person does, and what you want to learn. Use at least three T1 words. Speak for 30–45 seconds with a partner; every student speaks. No audio upload is required.
materials: 一张自画、公开资料或隐私安全的榜样图片，也可以只用姓名/称呼卡
